description: Per-session agentic traces from GitHub Copilot. One JSON object per agentic session (newline-delimited JSONL, gzip-compressed).

record.date: string (YYYY-MM-DD) - UTC partition date the session was sampled from

turns.turn_id: string - anonymized user turn id; one user request and its full agentic chain

llm_calls.model: string - anonymized model label ('Model A', 'Model B', ...; 'tool-model' = the instant-apply edit model used for certain tool calls)

message_metadata.type: string - message segment type (System, Context, UserMessage, ...)
message_metadata.sequenceId: number - ordering index within the prompt

tool_batches.duration_ms: number - batch wall-clock duration (parallel tools share one batch)
tool_batches.auto_continue: boolean - whether the agent auto-continued after this batch
tool_batches.request_id: string - anonymized id of the LLM request that triggered this batch
